def all_prefixes(string: str) -> List[str]:

from collections import Counter
from typing import List


def remove_duplicates(numbers: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    """Keep only values with one occurrence, in their original order."""
    counts = Counter(numbers)
    return [number for number in numbers if counts[number] == 1]

def filter_by_prefix(strings: List[str], prefix: str) -> List[str]:
    """Retain strings beginning with the supplied prefix."""
    return [text for text in strings if text.startswith(prefix)]

    """Collect unique common values and order the resulting matches."""
    left_values = set(l1)

    matches.sort()

def common(l1: list, l2: list):
    """Collect unique common values and order the resulting matches."""
    left_values = set(l1)
    right_values = set(l2)
    matches = list(filter(lambda value: value in right_values, left_values))
    matches.sort()
    return matches
